info.title: API.SH: VivaReal
info.description: The VivaReal API from API.SH: public VivaReal data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.summary: Fetch a past response again, free
get.description: The exact response a call returned, for 30 days after the call, at no cost. Use the call's x-request-id. Supports output=csv|ndjson.

200.description: The stored response (headers: x-refetch: 1, x-original-time, x-original-route).

404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

get.description:
A real estate agency or broker on VivaReal: name, CRECI license, tier, member since, rating, logo, phone numbers, verified flag, office address, total listings, and its first page of listings (id, link, title, sale or rent prices with condo fee and IPTU, bedrooms, bathrooms, suites, parking, areas, amenities, address with coordinates and photos).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/vivareal-agent

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: A vivareal.com.br/imobiliaria/<id>/ link (a listing's advertiser link).

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The advertiser number from that link instead of the url.

parameters.name: business
parameters.description: sale (default) or rent: which listings to show.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

listings.title: Apartamento para comprar com 138 m², 3 quartos, 3 banheiros, 2 vagas
Apartamento para comprar com 168 m², 3 quartos, 5 banheiros, 3 vagas

get.description:
Every listing of one VivaReal advertiser, 30 per page, for sale or for rent: id, link, title, prices with condo fee and IPTU, bedrooms, bathrooms, suites, parking, usable and total area, amenities, address with coordinates and photos, with the total. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/vivareal-agent-listings

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The advertiser number instead of the url.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

listings.title: Sala/Conjunto para comprar com 28 m², 1 banheiro
Apartamento para comprar com 73 m², 2 quartos, 3 banheiros, 1 vaga

get.description:
One VivaReal listing: title, description, status, types, prices (sale or rent with condo fee and IPTU), accepts exchange, bedrooms, bathrooms, suites, parking, areas, floor, buildings, delivery date, amenities, stamps, dates, external reference, full address with coordinates, photos (resized and original), videos and virtual tour, the site's price estimate (range per m² and for the property), condominium, and the advertiser (agency name, CRECI licence, logo, website, phones, WhatsApp, address and listing counts by city, neighbourhood and business, plus some of its other listings). A private owner's phones and address are left out. Pass `latest=true` with search filters to open the newest matching listing.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/vivareal-listing

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Listing id (the number after id- in a listing link). Or give `url`.

parameters.name: latest
parameters.description: true: open the first current result of a search made with the other filter params given here (the same as the search route's, e.g. location), instead of `id`/`url`.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

Cities, neighbourhoods and streets in Brazil matching a name, with zone, city, state, location id, coordinates, search link and match score.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/vivareal-places

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

places.location_id: BR>Rio de Janeiro>NULL>Rio de Janeiro>Zona Sul>Copacabana

get.description:
Homes and commercial property in Brazil on VivaReal with the site's filters: sale or rent, place (city or neighbourhood), property types, residential or commercial, price, bedrooms, bathrooms, suites, parking spaces, usable area, amenities and sort. Each result has id, link, title, types, prices (sale or rent, condo fee, yearly IPTU), bedrooms, bathrooms, suites, parking, areas, amenities, dates, full address with coordinates, photos, videos and the advertiser (agency name, CRECI licence, logo, page and phones; a private owner's phones are left out). Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page (the site shows up to 10,000 results).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/vivareal-search

parameters.name: location
parameters.description: City or neighbourhood name; the best match is used (see /vivareal/v1/places).

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: State name (e.g. São Paulo, Rio de Janeiro), with `city`.

parameters.name: unit_types
parameters.description: Property types, comma-separated: APARTMENT, HOME, CONDOMINIUM, PENTHOUSE, FLAT, KITNET, TWO_STORY_HOUSE, FARM, RESIDENTIAL_ALLOTMENT_LAND, COMMERCIAL_PROPERTY, OFFICE, BUSINESS, SHED_DEPOSIT_WAREHOUSE, COMMERCIAL_BUILDING, COMMERCIAL_ALLOTMENT_LAND, PARKING_SPACE, HOTEL.

parameters.name: amenities
parameters.description: Amenities, comma-separated: POOL, GYM, ELEVATOR, BARBECUE_GRILL, PARTY_HALL, PLAYGROUND, GATED_COMMUNITY, FURNISHED, PETS_ALLOWED, AIR_CONDITIONING, BALCONY, CONCIERGE_24H, SPORTS_COURT, SAUNA, ...

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number, starting at 1. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; it is null on the last page.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

address.location_id: BR>Rio de Janeiro>NULL>Rio de Janeiro>Zona Norte>Meier
BR>Rio de Janeiro>NULL>Rio de Janeiro>Zona Norte>Meier

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
